title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Croatian Salsa
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make fish dish featuring pan-seared snapper served with a refreshing Croatian-inspired salsa.
instructions: 1. Rinse the snapper fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
2. In a large bowl, mix together wet brine, snapper fillets, and a pinch of salt. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Remove snapper fillets from brine, shaking off excess liquid.
5. Add 2 tablespoons of oil to the skillet and sear snapper fillets for 3-4 minutes per side.
6. Transfer snapper fillets to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
7. In the same skillet, add 1/4 cup of chopped glassy croatian fish and cook for 1-2 minutes.
8. Stir in 1 cup of Croatian salsa and bring to a simmer.
9. Reduce heat to low and let the salsa simmer for 2-3 minutes.
10. To serve, place a snapper fillet on each plate, spoon some salsa over the top, and garnish with additional chopped glassy croatian fish if desired.
